content.where: text.md body and desktop-tiles/tile-00.png (Why Choose Us cards)
content.observed: all three 'Why Choose Us' cards read 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor.'
testimonials are 'Amazing!', 'Love it!', 'Wow!' attributed to John D., Sarah K., Mike R., each with one sentence and a star emoji; no company, role or outcome
'Welcome to the Future of Work' and 'Unlock your potential with our innovative, cutting-edge platform that empowers teams to achieve more, faster.' carry the page; 170 words total, 0 images
Analytics, Collaboration and Goals each get one real sentence ('Set and track goals to drive success across the organization.'); specific enough to not be placeholder, still generic

design: Replace the Arial stack with a deliberate pairing (one display face for H1/H2, one text face for body) and set a scale with distinct display, body and label sizes; keep it identical at 1440 and 390.
Drop the gradient text fill on the hero H1 (desktop-tiles/tile-00.png) and set it in solid white; the fade on 'Work' lowers contrast on the blue end for no gain.
Break the three-identical-card pattern: give Why Choose Us a different layout (a two-column feature with an image or figure), keep cards for one section only.
Replace emoji with a single drawn icon set at one stroke weight and one size so the cards read as one system.
usability: On mobile the nav overflows at 390 px (mobile/frame-00.png): collapse the five links into a menu button below about 768 px, or wrap them; today 'About' is clipped and 'Contact' is unreachable.
Add aria-label or visually hidden text on each card's icon glyph (or make the emoji aria-hidden) so the card title alone carries meaning for screen readers.
Give the nav links and both CTAs real targets (the probe shows no routes); a 'Pricing' link with nowhere to go is a dead end on the first screen.
creativity: Pick one idea native to 'the future of work' and carry it through: for example a single product screenshot or illustration of the actual tool, used in the hero and echoed in each feature card.
Replace the repeated card grid in at least one section with a different composition (a pinned feature walkthrough, a before/after, a numbered list) so the page has a shape of its own.
If motion is added, make it one authored move (a reveal tied to the product idea), not card fade-ins.
content: Replace the three lorem ipsum paragraphs in Why Choose Us (desktop-tiles/tile-00.png) with one specific sentence each: what is fast, measured how; what is secured, by what.
Replace the 'Amazing!' / 'Love it!' / 'Wow!' testimonials with named people at named companies stating a concrete outcome, or remove the section.
Rewrite the H1 and subhead to say what Nexora is and who it is for; 'Welcome to the Future of Work' and 'Unlock your potential' do not identify the product.
Add at least one real image or product view; the probe counts 0 images, so the page has no imagery to judge.
